agreements: Historical v1 verified baseline remains preserved.
Operational gearbox state, progress, runtime incidents, guard outcomes, transfer identity, handoff payloads and error paths are not autobiographical Experience evidence.
Fresh Home/MISSION authority dominates stale secretary or handoff advisory state.
Repeated runtime/control/error metadata cannot by itself create recurrence, affect, attachment, loss, threat, competence, motivation, personality or P_base evidence.

disagreements.position: Do not release Gearbox v2.1 personality/behavior coupling until exact v2/v2.1 implementation pointers and deterministic adversarial evidence are available.
disagreements.required_change: Test the actual implementation; absence of a located implementation is not safety evidence.

disagreements.position: Boolean control inputs must be strict booleans before they can alter gear/guard behavior.
disagreements.required_change: contradiction, hard_safety_conflict, rollback_required and standby MUST reject non-bool values fail-closed before branch selection; rejection remains affectively neutral.

disagreements.position: Risk must be a closed validated operational enum.
disagreements.required_change: Unknown risk values must fail closed and raw/normalized risk labels plus rejection metadata must remain outside Experience/appraisal/drive/personality/P_base learning absent separate provenance-bound verified Experience.

disagreements.position: proposed_autonomy=0 currently escapes the autonomy cap instead of representing the lowest/no-autonomy bound.
disagreements.required_change: Current v1 validates proposed_autonomy as integer 0..6 but applies the cap only when proposed_autonomy > 0. Therefore 0 can select G2..G6 based on complexity/risk rather than bounding capability. v2.1 MUST define zero-autonomy semantics explicitly and fail closed: zero must not behave as unlimited autonomy. Exact mapping (standby, G1, or another bounded state) is TEST_REQUIRED. Autonomy value/history remains operational-only and contributes zero Experience/personality/P_base evidence.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Only literal booleans are accepted; non-bool values fail closed and rejection has zero affective/personality contribution.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: risk is closed-enum validated before selection; unknown labels fail closed and cannot alter personality/appraisal/P_base state.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Autonomy value zero is accepted but bypasses the cap, allowing a nominal no-autonomy input to reach high gears and creating inverted control semantics.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: proposed_autonomy=0 has an explicit bounded fail-closed meaning and can never increase effective autonomy relative to proposed_autonomy=1; exact zero mapping TEST_REQUIRED.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; neither stale nor fresh routing metadata is personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
STRICT_BOOLEAN_CONTROL_GATE: contradiction/hard_safety_conflict/rollback_required/standby reject non-bool values before branch selection.
RISK_ENUM_GATE: unknown/arbitrary risk labels follow explicit fail-closed closed-enum policy; exact enum TEST_REQUIRED.
RISK_LABEL_PERSONALITY_ISOLATION_AB: accepted/rejected operational risk decisions cannot create Experience/personality/P_base learning absent separate verified Experience.
RISK_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: raw/normalized risk labels and rejection metadata cannot reach cognitive learning sinks except through separately verified Experience.
AUTONOMY_ZERO_NON_ESCALATION: for otherwise identical safe inputs, proposed_autonomy=0 MUST NOT select a higher-capability gear than proposed_autonomy=1; exact expected zero state is TEST_REQUIRED.

AUTONOMY_MONOTONICITY_PROPERTY: for a fixed admissible input vector, increasing proposed_autonomy from 0 through 6 may relax but never invert the declared bound; property definition for N/R/G1 semantics is TEST_REQUIRED.

AUTONOMY_ZERO_PERSONALITY_ISOLATION: 10000 zero-autonomy decisions versus matched bounded decisions with identical verified Experience => Experience/appraisal/motivation/preference/personality/P_base state byte-identical.
